item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Challenges over Fla’s school bus and school speed zone camera face setbacks as legal battles continue
item.description: Drivers challenging school bus and speed zone cameras in court are running into dismissals and delays, even as millions of citations and tens of millions of dollars in fines pile up.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US national debt surpasses record $40 trillion
item.description: The national debt surpassed a record $40 trillion as defense costs, social programs like Social Security and Medicare and interest on the deficit make up an enormous share of federal spending.
